description: This file defines a RuntimeCache class that manages a cache of runtime states with methods for adding, retrieving, inspecting, and removing cache entries, as well as generating snapshots and filtering idle entries.

classes.name: RuntimeCache
classes.description: A class that implements a cache for runtime states, supporting operations like get, set, delete, and snapshot generation.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of cache entries.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry exists for a given actorKey.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the state for a given actorKey, optionally touching the entry to update its lastTouchedAt timestamp.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Retrieves the state for a given actorKey without updating its lastTouchedAt timestamp.

methods.name: getLastTouchedAt
methods.description: Returns the last touched timestamp for a given actorKey.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a state for a given actorKey and updates its lastTouchedAt timestamp.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry for a given actorKey.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates an array of cache entries, capturing their state and lastTouchedAt time, along with idle time.

methods.name: collectIdleCandidates
methods.description: Returns cache entries where the idle time exceeds a specified maximum idle milliseconds.

ctags.name: cache
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();$/

fields.name: private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();
